## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Commits are atomic Conventional Commits

- [ ] Docs and ADRs are updated, or no change was needed
- [ ] Every new Cosmo or AWS claim is in `docs/VERIFIED_FACTS.md`
